
== CreateWebsite with a copy
steps: Create Unix user | Copy databases | Pull and check image signature | Start container in gVisor | Configure edge proxy | Get TLS certificate
long: true
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/homes/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o root -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o staging_ab12 -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app
$ loginctl enable-linger staging_ab12
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- mkdir -p -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app/public
$ systemctl start user@20001.service
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- tar --create --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app -- . | runuser -u staging_ab12 -- tar --extract --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app --no-same-owner --preserve-permissions
$ ip address replace 169.254.80.1/20 dev lo
$ systemctl daemon-reload
$ install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 $DIR/cf-db $DIR/cf-db/servers $DIR/cf-db/homes
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/cf-db/homes/db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ loginctl enable-linger db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ systemctl start user@10002.service
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/disk
$ install -d -o db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -m 0700 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/disk/data
$ chown root:db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2/postgresql.env
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman image exists ghcr.io/cloudfactory/postgresql:latest
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2@ restart cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2.service
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_isready --quiet --host=127.0.0.1 --port=5432 --timeout=5
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE CONNECT ON DATABASE postgres, template1 FROM PUBLIC;
  | DO $$DECLARE r name; BEGIN
  |   FOR r IN SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'cfrestore\_%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = rolname) LOOP
  |     EXECUTE format('DROP ROLE IF EXISTS %I', r);
  |   END LOOP;
  | END$$;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'staging_ab12_shop';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:rw" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:ro" NOLOGIN;
  | CREATE DATABASE "staging_ab12_shop" OWNER "staging_ab12_shop:rw";
  | REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE "staging_ab12_shop" FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE "staging_ab12_shop" TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
  | \connect "staging_ab12_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "cfrestore_RANDOM" LOGIN PASSWORD 'HEX24';
  | GRANT "staging_ab12_shop:rw" TO "cfrestore_RANDOM";
$ chown db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --host=127.0.0.1 --username=cfrestore_RANDOM --dbname=staging_ab12_shop --no-psqlrc --quiet --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | \connect "staging_ab12_shop"
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DO $$DECLARE s name; BEGIN
  |   FOR s IN SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner = '"staging_ab12_shop:rw"'::regrole AND nspname <> 'public' LOOP
  |     EXECUTE format('DROP SCHEMA %I CASCADE', s);
  |   END LOOP;
  | END$$;
  | DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
  | CREATE SCHEMA public AUTHORIZATION pg_database_owner;
  | REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
  | GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
  | ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE "staging_ab12_shop:rw" IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO "staging_ab12_shop:ro";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_dump --username=postgres --format=custom --no-owner --no-privileges acme_x7k2_shop | runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 pg_restore --host=127.0.0.1 --username=cfrestore_RANDOM --role=staging_ab12_shop:rw --dbname=staging_ab12_shop --no-owner --no-privileges --clean --if-exists --exit-on-error
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "cfrestore_RANDOM";
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'staging_ab12_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'staging_ab12_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | CREATE ROLE "staging_ab12_app" LOGIN CONNECTION LIMIT 80 PASSWORD 'Abcdefgh12345678';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10002 podman exec -i cf-postgresql-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d2 psql --username=postgres --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --no-align
  | SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp;
  | GRANT "staging_ab12_shop:rw" TO "staging_ab12_app";
  | ALTER ROLE "staging_ab12_app" IN DATABASE "staging_ab12_shop" SET role = 'staging_ab12_shop:rw';
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/20001 podman pull --quiet ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ restart cf-staging_ab12.service

--- $DIR/units/20001/cf-staging_ab12.container (-rw-r--r--)

  Description=Website acme.example

  ContainerName=cf-staging_ab12
  Image=ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1

  PodmanArgs=--no-hosts
  Volume=$DIR/config/staging_ab12/hosts:/etc/hosts:ro
  Volume=$DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app:/app:Z
  Volume=$DIR/config/staging_ab12/php.ini:/usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/zz-cloudfactory.ini:ro,Z
  Label=io.cloudfactory.website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1

  Environment=CF_DOCUMENT_ROOT=/app/public
  NoNewPrivileges=true
  DropCapability=all
  ReadOnly=true

  UserNS=keep-id
  LogDriver=k8s-file

  CPUQuota=100%

  MemorySwapMax=0
  TasksMax=100
